name: grc-core
description: Governance, Risk & Compliance skills. Includes security-review-travel-risk (international travel work-request risk review), tprm-security-review (read-only third-party/vendor security risk review scoring Likelihood × Impact on the sanctioned matrix), and tprm-vendor-review-update (gated write-back of an approved review outcome to the compliance platform — Drata in the reference configuration — and the inventory). Recommendation only — never approves, sends, or acts.
